purpose: Frozen target-agnostic cluster-marker rules before external annotation. Exploratory labels, not validated classifiers.
clustering: Each dataset independently; original TAM/Myeloid plus Unknown/unclassified candidates; CP10K log1p,2000 Seurat HVG excluding PGAM5,30PC,15NN,igraph Leiden0.8,seed0
QC: Retain previous QC>=500 genes,MT<20%; HCC tumors only
rules_in_priority_order: Mast: at least two of TPSAB1/TPSB2/KIT detection>=0.2
pDC: GZMB>=0.3, at least two of TCF4/IL3RA/CLEC4C>=0.1,CD3D<0.2
T_NK: either at least two of CD3D/CD3E/TRAC>=0.3 or GNLY>=0.3 and NKG7>=0.4;C1QC<0.2
Tumor_hepatocyte: EPCAM/KRT19 both>=0.2 or ALB/APOA1 both>=0.4;TYROBP<0.2,C1QC<0.2
missing_markers: Missing gene is not zero. A rule with missing required markers is ineligible; no invented cDC1/cDC2 subclass unless supported.
target: Only cells in Macrophage clusters split by raw PGAM5>0 vs0. This revises lineage labels, not PGAM5 detection threshold.
external: GSE189903 HCC core+border; rules frozen, expression never used for feature selection or configuration tuning. Earlier exploratory analyses involved this dataset; not prospectively untouched.
